name: Hill Rank-19 K3
description: C. R. Hill's generic rank ≥19 family from two quadratic covers of an elliptic K3 surface. Integer search inputs index points on the positive-rank genus-one parameter curve; each fiber needs its own rank certificate. Paper: https://hillaxiom.com/papers/k3-19-sections.html
author: C. R. Hill

paper.title: Nineteen Independent Sections from Two Quadratic Covers of an Elliptic K3 Surface

family.label: Ratpoints stages
family.help: Height stages for searching beyond the 19 specialized construction points.

target.label: Ratpoints stages
target.help: Height stages for the selected elliptic curve.

provenance.construction: Two exact conic lifts of ICARM #3900 neighbor 028, cover indices 4339 and 36773; positive-rank auxiliary genus-one base
provenance.claim_boundary: Generic lower bound is over Q(E_aux). It is not a rank-19 claim over the unrestricted parent Q(t), and no specialized fiber rank follows without an exact certificate.
